findings.issue: Successful worker PROBE_RESULT is checked without the original serialized-probe command and lane completion. The producer writes RESULT in its worker before the outer serializer and dispatcher finish; outer failure/interruption could leave that successful worker record eligible for formal acceptance.
findings.requested_resolution: Read/bind/publish existing serialized-probe-command.json, serialized-probe.log and LANE.json; check exact original serialized argv, cwd, exit zero, empty built/failed sets, log fingerprint and final lane state. Do not rerun the probe merely to obtain these existing receipts.

findings.issue: The failed result is hash-bound and asserts the expected source SHA, but archived source bytes themselves are only compared to publication, not to that SHA. A copied wrong failed source could be published consistently while the referenced result identifies another source.
findings.requested_resolution: Also require digest(regular(prior/NAME)) == f["source_sha256"] and corresponding bytes when available, and bind the recorded failure command/log fields to the existing raw log.
